Atmosphere:
The air carries the scent of fertile soil, blooming flowers in spring and summer, and the crispness of the sea breeze near the coast. Gentle winds rustle through the fields and trees, creating a peaceful, natural ambiance. Temperatures vary from mild summers to cool, damp winters.

Dominant: Earthy Greens (fields, forests), Secondary: Deep Red (farmhouses, barns)
